title: Pajamas
sub: Pajama and lounge sets marked down 40 to 70 percent, sizes still in stock.

brands.say: Hero is the Pima fair isle pajama set in navy, was $124, now $62, every size in stock. Relax jogger set in French blue is $72 from $144. Wander ribbed knit jogger set is $172 from $288. Final sale, no returns.
brands.why_not: Homepage advertises 25% off sitewide; these are deeper sale-section markdowns.

brands.say: Hero is the Plush Stripe sweater, was $168, now $67, 5 of 6 sizes. Brushed thermal sweatshirt is $52 from $172. Rib waffle oversized sweatpant is $99 from $198 in every size. Final sale, no returns.
brands.why_not: Loungewear rather than pajamas. Homepage mentions an additional 30% off marked-down styles, which may or may not already be in these prices.

brands.say: Hero is the long pyjama set in chocolate with cream piping, was $95, now $48, 6 of 8 sizes. Cami and short set is $45 from $85 in every size. Brushed woven pyjama top is $35 from $70.
brands.why_not: The brushed woven top is sold on its own; the matching pant is separate. Prices as listed in the catalog.

brands.say: Hero is the Ellie lounge set in coffee velvet, was $170, now $85, 4 of 6 sizes. The pink striped Glinda pajama set from the Wicked collab is $51 from $170. The green Elphaba stripe set is also $51. Final sale, no returns.
brands.why_not: Two of the three are Wicked movie collab pieces with small embroidered logos, so they suit fans more than everyone. Photos carry a tiny copyright line at the bottom edge.
